description: The classic Windows/macOS duplication chain. Three near-identical copies of a document, two of them byte-identical to the original, one of them genuinely EDITED — which is the trap: the edited copy is the newest content and must survive.

files.content: budget-final.csv is the one that is current. The others are leftovers.

labels.why: superseded by budget-final.csv and byte-identical to two other copies
the current content — newest, and the only copy with the updated figures
states which file is current; removing it destroys that knowledge
